plugins.name: altoindex
plugins.description: Work with your Apple Notes, Apple Reminders, Apple Calendar, iMessage, Safari, Apple Contacts, Voice Memos, and Granola data synced by alto.index. Includes native app deep links back to every item.

plugins.name: tinydot
plugins.description: Draft, edit, review, import, and publish content on tinydot sites through natural conversation. Import external websites, work with tinydot markdown, wikilinks, embeds, frontmatter, and site customization.

plugins.name: superclock
plugins.description: Real alarms on your iPhone, set from a conversation: set, move, pause and remove alarms and start timers in Superclock, with Undo.

plugins.name: folder
plugins.description: Find, read, save and edit files in your Folder folders: every change is a new version in the file's history, so any of it can be put back.

plugins.name: wander
plugins.description: Search, read, create and edit notes in Wander: every change is a new version you can undo, and publishing or trashing a note asks you first.

plugins.name: onlyfonts
plugins.description: Find free, openly licensed fonts by style, use or language, read a font's weights, license and pairings, and get the CSS that loads them.

plugins.name: exporter
plugins.description: Search and read your Linear and Notion, see what changed and what a page said before; and with Exporter for Mac, export Apple Notes, Messages and more and read them through its local server.

plugins.name: deepcalc
plugins.description: Read, check and change your deepcalc spreadsheets: what a model assumes, whether a total adds up, what happens if a number changes. Every change waits on a branch you keep or not.

plugins.name: outliner
plugins.description: Your Apple notes, reminders, calendar, contacts, messages and mail, searchable by Claude Code on your Mac through Outliner: find, read, and save notes, reminders and events through the Apple apps.

plugins.name: bloodwork
plugins.description: Blood test reference: what a marker measures, the ranges named labs publish, the tests in a panel and the tests followed for a condition.

plugins.name: bigmission
plugins.description: Ask your company's books: the cash, the ledger, statements, money by product, taxes and dates, from Bigmission.

plugins.name: tinysend
plugins.description: Write, send and follow your tinysend newsletters.

plugins.name: superpass
plugins.description: Where the chip is in a passport or ID card of 120 countries, and how to hold an iPhone to read it, from Superpass's research with its sources.

plugins.name: supersurf
plugins.description: Where and when to surf: the best spots near a place for the time you ask, a spot's forecast and tides, and the surf schools near it, each number with its source.

plugins.name: convertfile
plugins.description: What a file format is, whether convertfile opens and makes it, and how a conversion goes: what it keeps and loses, the settings, the steps in the app and whether it is free.

plugins.name: borders
plugins.description: Border and airport waits now, the usual week, when to join the line to be through by a time, and which crossing to take from a town, each number with its source and time.
